source_title: My Hero Academia: 6 Strongest Power-Ups of Izuku Midoriya, Ranked
source_excerpt:
Cathlyn is an anime writer with years of experience covering some of the biggest and most popular series of all time. She loves writing listicles, features, and query-based articles about all things related to anime. Outside of writing, she enjoys playing mobile games, building Lego and Nanoblock sets, playing pickleball, watching movies, and rewatching her favorite anime series. Before joining GameRant as a contributor, she worked in Epicstream’s anime department. Beyond her passion for anime, she also enjoys writing romance fiction, with her most successful work surpassing one million reads on Wattpad.
Izuku Midoriya's professional hero dream officially comes true in My Hero Academia , ranking fourth in the Hero Billboard Chart in the present era. Once a useless, Quirkless civilian, Izuku becomes a major ally of justice on the battlefield, fighting near-invincible villains such as Overhaul, Shigaraki, and the ever-ruthless All For One .
With the One For All quirk, Izuku becomes a worthy successor to the eighth user, All Might. This god-tier Quirk plays a crucial role in Izuku's growth throughout My Hero Academia , as every new power-up he unlocks grants him more combat options and allows him to handle even the most untouchable foes.
6 Izuku's Full Gauntlet Lets Him Use One For All at Maximum Power
Izuku is clearly fond of using exceptional gauntlets and gloves while fighting. From his air force gauntlets to his mid-gauntlets, Izuku relies on these useful support items to enhance his offensive and defensive abilities and, at the same time, minimize the painful strain of One For All.
Likewise, the Full Gauntlet that Melissa Shield develops for Izuku in My Hero Academia: Two Heroes helps him unleash One For All's full power without suffering severe injuries. During Izuku's heroic adventures on I-Island, he relied on the Full Gauntlet to unleash not just one, but three One For All smashes at maximum power without injuring himself.
5 Izuku's Costume Zeta Is Built for the Final War
Among Izuku Midoriya's hero costumes , the Zeta version is undeniably one of the best when it comes to combat effectiveness. It boasts enhanced arm bracers, iron soles, and even mid-gauntlets that allow Izuku to unleash One For All attacks at increased percentages. This costume wouldn't be possible without the combined efforts of Mei Hatsume and Melissa Shield.
In addition, Costume Zeta serves as Izuku's battle outfit during the climactic war against Tomura Shigaraki, providing him with the support he needs to face his archenemy. Without this costume, Izuku would have struggled to withstand Shigaraki's attacks in their final showdown.
4 Izuku's New Armored Suit Gives Him the Power to Fight With His Friends Again
Following his climactic battle against Tomura Shigaraki, Izuku loses One For All and its stored quirks, leaving him Quirkless once again. Although Izuku continues his hero duties in the U.A. classroom rather than on the battlefield, leaving him Quirkless at the end of My Hero Academia feels like an unfair and disappointing conclusion to his long journey.
Fortunately, Melissa Shield, All Might, and the rest of Izuku's friends provide him with an advanced armored suit that allows him to return to the battlefield and replicate the abilities of One For All and its stored Quirks. With his armored suit and years of combat experience, Izuku effortlessly returns to the front lines as if he had never lost the One For All Quirk.
3 Eri's Rewind Quirk Turns Izuku Into a Near-Invincible One For All User
Izuku's phenomenal display of power during his ultimate fight against Overhaul remains one of the most memorable moments in My Hero Academia . With Eri by his side, Izuku gains access to Infinite 100% Full Cowl without suffering the devastating physical consequences of pushing One For All beyond his limits.
While Izuku continues to push One For All to its limits, Eri's Rewind counteracts the physical damage he sustains, making them an incredibly effective combat duo capable of overwhelming even the most formidable opponents. As a result, even Overhaul's most powerful form could not withstand Izuku's absurd power.
2 One For All's Stored Powers Transform Izuku's Fighting Style
Inheriting One For All allows Izuku to access the quirks of its previous stewards, giving him a diverse collection of unique abilities that prove crucial to his growth as the new Symbol of Peace. With these additional powers at his disposal, Izuku gains greater versatility in combat, allowing him to adapt to different opponents and overcome challenges that would otherwise be beyond his power level.
From Smokescreen and Gearshift to Danger Sense, Izuku eventually learns to master the stored quirks with guidance from the previous users' vestiges, allowing him to unlock their full potential and incorporate them into his unique fighting style. By the end of the series, Izuku can even use all these Quirks simultaneously with ease.
1 One For All Gives Izuku the Strength to Change the World
Without a doubt, One For All is a god-tier Quirk that can be passed down from one user to another, regardless of whether the recipient already has an existing Quirk or is otherwise Quirkless. For Izuku, who never awakens an extraordinary Quirk of his own, inheriting One For All becomes a major power upgrade that transforms him from a vulnerable boy into one of the most overpowered heroes in the series.
He becomes the ninth user of One For All by consuming a strand of All Might's hair, allowing him to inherit the powerful Quirk and begin his long and difficult journey toward becoming an exceptional hero. Under Izuku's stewardship, One For All reaches new levels of power as he learns to harness its immense stockpiled power.
